name: Shortling Federations
background: The Gangs of New Eden are various factions of violent and deranged outlaws that wage eternal gang wars on the streets of New Eden. These gangs are joined by mercenaries which are not bound to any particular gang, and which fight for anyone that can provide riches or a worthy cause.

specialRules.name: Repel Ambushers
specialRules.description: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.

specialRules.name: Precision Frenzy
specialRules.description: Place one token on this unit when it fully destroys an enemy unit, up to a max. of two tokens. For each token all models with this rule in this unit get +1 to hit rolls until the end of the game.

specialRules.name: Armor
specialRules.description: Counts as having Defense X+.

specialRules.name: Precision Fighter Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get +1 to hit rolls in melee. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Safety Gear
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have this rule, as long as they haven't started an activation yet this round, they get +1 to Defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Safety Gear
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have Safety Gear, they always get +1 to Defense rolls from Safety Gear (instead of only as long as they haven't started an activation yet).

specialRules.name: Rending when Shooting Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Rending when shooting. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Regeneration Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Regeneration. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Teleport Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Teleport. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Safety Gear Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Enhanced Safety Gear. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Morale Debuff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which gets -1 to Morale Test rolls once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Ignores Cover
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

specialRules.name: Destructive
specialRules.description: When attacking units with more than half of their total size or Tough value (for single-model units), those hits get AP(+1).

specialRules.name: Guarded
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have this rule, as long as they haven't started an activation yet this round, they get +1 to Defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Enhanced Guarded
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have Guarded, they always get +1 to Defense rolls from Guarded (instead of only as long as they haven't started an activation yet).

specialRules.name: Ambush
specialRules.description: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be deployed anywhere over 9” away from enemy units. Players alternate in placing Ambush units, starting with the player that activates next. Units that deploy via Ambush can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy.

specialRules.name: Defense
specialRules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Rending
specialRules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and for each unmodified result of 6 to hit, those hits get AP(+4).

specialRules.name: Regeneration
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

specialRules.name: Teleport
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, you may place this model anywhere fully within 3" of its position when using Advance/Charge actions, or fully within 6" of its position when using Rush actions.

specialRules.name: Tough
specialRules.description: Once a model has taken as many wounds as its Tough value, it is killed (remove from play).

specialRules.name: AP
specialRules.description: Targets get -X to Defense rolls when blocking hits.

specialRules.name: Fearless
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule fails a Morale Test, roll one die. On a 4+ it counts as passed instead.

specialRules.name: Deadly
specialRules.description: Assign each wound to one model, and multiply it by X. Hits from Deadly must be resolved first, and these wounds don’t carry over to other models if the original target is killed.
